real_source_read_only_run.materials: Exact independently verified replay consumed-review.json; includes original financial summary, assumptions, facts, counterevidence and unapproved G3.
real_source_read_only_run.materiality_reason: The frozen candidate has no event_scan_ref; no foreign or incomplete event scan is substituted.

integration_contract.registered_replay: Independently resolve current Web replay publication and candidate; use existing pending-response preview/signature contract and replay consumed-review packet.
integration_contract.invalid_registered_replay: NOT_READY without signing instructions, or propagated verification error without output; never fallback to canonical candidate. Explicit null registry entry is invalid.
integration_contract.absent_symbol: Existing canonical publication selector and legacy checks unchanged.
integration_contract.bound_draft: Existing source-bound draft path unchanged; no replay is presented as a bound draft.
integration_contract.current_policy_basis: Existing applicable value-policy review loader, current research basis and valuation artifact comparison remain enforced.
integration_contract.event_materiality: For replay only, prepare read-only materiality handoff from exact replay package/scan and compare descriptor; no registered-materiality writes or foreign-model substitution.
integration_contract.external_authority: Unsigned response has no reviewer identity, reviewed_at or whole_model_approval. A pinned root never mints reviewer authority.
integration_contract.root_remaining: Root owns app/types/UI/config and authenticated button/browser acceptance; this verifies the existing product handoff entrypoint, not an HTTP/browser run.
